# anonymiq

> Python web service (FastAPI on Microsoft Presidio) that finds personal data in Dutch text and PDF documents, replaces it with placeholders, and can restore it for authorised users; OpenRegister calls it over HTTP.

The API serves its OpenAPI schema at runtime on `/api/v1/openapi.json` (Swagger UI on `/api/v1/docs`); no OpenAPI document is committed to this repository.

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): setup, build, test, lint and quality commands, conventions and commit style
